policy: For each exact canonical terminal G5/scene/G6 slot reached by the 86 approved directional exits, copy the persistent acoustic scale value of its exact G4 generated-family profiles. All families within each G4 agree. This is a new low-confidence editorial applicability judgment for the canonical scene, not automatic inheritance or a historical measurement. Values 0 and 1 retain the independently approved family policy: 0 means no persistent masking penalty, not silence; 1 ordinary moving-water masking. Temporary events and weather remain separate; no level 2 is authored.
source_boundary: Exact canonical G5, source profile, scene and slot identities are direct catalog copies. Landscape/land-use/function classifications keep the evidence directness and confidence below. Numeric values and their applicability to canonical endpoints are analogical/low editorial authoring, requiring this separate approval.
